verdict.rationale: Fivetran is offered only as a managed SaaS with an optional 'Hybrid Deployment' agent that runs locally but still relies on Fivetran's cloud control plane; there is no evidence of an option to self-host the core platform itself. Community commentary even contrasts Fivetran with genuinely self-hostable open-source alternatives like Airbyte, underscoring that Fivetran itself is not self-hostable.
